facts.fact: 派对宾客陆续到达时，Margo 乘黑色 Daimler 抵达 Rushwood，Lawrence 冲出房子到车道迎接，她下车直扑进他怀里。
facts.anchor: when a glossy black Daimler pulled up, its uniformed driver at the wheel. Lawrence burst out of the house, into the drive, and a woman jumped out of the car straight into his arms.

facts.fact: 目击拥抱与被朝自己方向一指之后，Miriam 觉得羞辱像热油一样当头浇下。
facts.anchor: Humiliation poured over me, hot as oil.

facts.fact: Margo 赞许地点头，要 Miriam 保持那股 scrappy spirit（倔劲）。
facts.anchor: You keep that scrappy spirit, Miriam.

facts.fact: Whipple 临别真心称赞 Miriam 是他用过的最好助手。
facts.anchor: The best assistant I’ve ever had.

facts.fact: 厨房对峙中，Pa 引酒馆与 Doris 的传闻反对赴会：Harold 的圈子非常 murky，Kray 兄弟来过上次派对。
facts.anchor: Doris says the Krays came to the last bash. Polite as pie, they were. But still.

facts.fact: Pa 翻过请柬发作：Celia 让他们晚饭后才来，正说明 Caswells 看不起他家。
facts.anchor: Celia decrees you come after dinner, eh? Says it all.

facts.fact: Ma 拍板让 Alf 也去照看两个妹妹，借 Pa 的丧礼服赴会。
Miriam 为活跃气氛说漏 Rafe 昨天从 Celia 卧室提着裤链出来；Pa 笑得停不下来，Ma 骂她 Loose lips sink ships 并叫她收拾盘子。
facts.anchor: I saw Rafe coming out of Celia’s bedroom, zipping up his flies.
